values.note: $28 a site includes two vehicles or one RV/trailer with its tow vehicle; a third vehicle is $11. Cash, check or money order at the self-service fee tube for first-come sites.

Two vehicles or one recreational vehicle (RV) per site is included in the camping fee. $11 fee for a third vehicle.'; 'A self-service fee tube is available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232341/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06 and 2027: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 28, TENT ONLY 28), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 14 RV/trailer sites and 4 tent-only (8, 11, 12, 13) on two loops; the west loop is mostly shaded by ponderosa pine, the east loop more open. The Forest Service gives parking spurs up to 30 ft and says the narrow road and spurs are not recommended for large motorhomes or trailers; recreation.gov says rigs over 36 ft will have a very tough time on the tight corners. One RV per site; every vehicle must fit on the gravel spur.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/painted-rocks-campground ('has 18 campsites with parking areas up to 30 feet long'; 'This campground has a narrow road and campsite spurs and is not recommended for large motorhomes or large trailers'; 'Sites 8, 11, 12 and 13 are tent only sites.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232341 ('RV or trailers over 36 feet will have a very tough time making it through the campground because of tight corners and trees.'; 'All vehicles including campers must fit in parking spur'; 'single-family sites on two loops'; 'Roads and parking spurs are gravel') + catalog 232341 (site 015 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Drinking water (no hoses on hydrants to fill RVs), trash dumpsters, picnic table and fire ring at each site; campground host; firewood $10 a bundle.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/painted-rocks-campground ('There is drinking water available in the campground, as well as trash dumpsters and vault toilets'; 'Potable water is available. values.note: Typically open the week of Memorial Day through Labor Day weekend.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/painted-rocks-campground ('This campground is typically open from the week of Memorial Day through Labor Day weekend.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Limited sites reservable on recreation.gov or 877-444-6777 up to six months and at least four days ahead; 6 sites are first-come (must be occupied the same night). Two-night weekend and three-night holiday-weekend minimums; 14 nights in a rolling 60 days. Reservation season 2026 May 22 - Sept 6 (2027: June 5 - Sept 6). Check in with the host.

note: Pikes Peak Ranger District (Pike NF) campground at 7,800 ft on the edge of a grassy meadow, 7 miles north of Woodland Park off CO-67, then 1/2 mile up gravel Painted Rocks Road; named for streaked sandstone outcrops. The paved Centennial Bike Trail, half a mile away, runs to Colorado and South Meadows campgrounds and Manitou Lake. --Claude
